verdict.rationale: CrewAI documents Flows as structured, event-driven workflows that connect tasks and Crews, manage shared state, and control the flow of execution. It also documents sequential and hierarchical processes and visual task dependencies in Crew Studio. The pack, however, never explicitly shows branching, loops, or parallel steps, so only the core of the story (an explicit workflow) is evidenced. Missing for 10: documented conditional branching/routing, loop constructs, parallel step execution, and independent or hands-on corroboration of Flow composition.
